en: Black‑and‑white view down a cobblestone village street lined with plastered houses with steep tiled roofs and wooden shutters. A woman and a small child walk in the middle of the street while chickens wander nearby. Trees and garden fences flank the road. In the background, on a hill above the town, stands a large medieval brick or stone castle complex with a high round tower and multiple gabled roofs, dominating the skyline.
